title: Mellarum - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Mellarum in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Mellarum is a physical-element weapon used by Maelle. It scales with Vitality (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Mellarum Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Vitality (B), Luck (C). A physical-scaling weapon, so it fits any build that is not committed to a specific element.
